item.title: Launch
item.description:
We are excited to announce that we are launching The Circuit, a student-run newspaper based on the Purdue Indianapolis campus!

As Purdue in Indianapolis has developed in the past two years and continues to grow rapidly, we see the need for a student newspaper focused on serving our community.
